changeSet.author: datalens
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE dl_identity_revision ADD CONSTRAINT dl_identity_revision_nonnegative CHECK (profile_revision >= 0 AND security_revision >= 0)
ALTER TABLE dl_identity_outbox ADD CONSTRAINT dl_identity_outbox_size CHECK (octet_length(payload) <= 16384)

changeSet.author: datalens
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION public.dl_identity_purge_published() RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $$ WITH expired AS ( SELECT event_id FROM public.dl_identity_outbox WHERE published_at < now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY published_at, event_id LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), deleted AS ( DELETE FROM public.dl_identity_outbox AS outbox USING expired WHERE outbox.event_id = expired.event_id RETURNING 1 ) SELECT count(*) FROM deleted $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.dl_identity_purge_published() FROM PUBLIC
